تستنقذن (form X)
# تَسْتَنْقِذْنَ (tastanqiḏna) /tas.tan.qið.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْقَذَ (istanqaḏa)
# تُسْتَنْقَذْنَ (tustanqaḏna) /tus.tan.qað.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْقَذَ (istanqaḏa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
